speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Renal Tuberculosis.

The combination of painless hematuria (often presenting as microscopic), right flank pain, and a previous clinical suspicion of TB—despite the lack of classic systemic symptoms like fever—is highly suggestive of genitourinary tuberculosis. The pending NAAT results will likely confirm this diagnosis. I am waiting for the ultrasound results to check for any structural changes or calcifications, but the clinical picture strongly points to this etiology.
